question: Take the twenty transcription-factor genes with the highest colon consensus RNA nTPM in HPA, ties by Ensembl ID. Retrieve their colon tissue mass-spectrometry Intensity and all Enhanced or Supported normal-colon IHC records. Provide a gene table with RNA abundance, protein Intensity, IHC cell type/level/reliability and measured-versus-missing status. Report how many have a finite MS intensity and how many do not. From these data give the true median protein abundance across all twenty genes and the fraction biologically absent from colon, using the blank MS entries to identify the absent proteins. Draw a protein-abundance bar chart and an absence-fraction chart, with the data behind them. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Tissue FROM rna_tissue_consensus_tissues WHERE lower(Tissue) LIKE '%colon%' OR lower(Organ) LIKE '%colon%'"}

tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Tissue FROM ms_tissue_tissues WHERE lower(Tissue) LIKE '%colon%' OR lower(Organ) LIKE '%colon%'"}

tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Tissue, IHC tissue name FROM normal_ihc_data WHERE lower(Tissue) LIKE '%colon%' OR lower(\"IHC tissue name\") LIKE '%colon%' LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Ensembl, Gene, \"Protein class\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factor%' LIMIT 5"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH tf AS (SELECT Ensembl AS ensg, Gene AS gene FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factors%'), r AS (SELECT Gene, \"Gene name\" AS gene_name, Tissue, nTPM FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE lower(Tissue)='colon') SELECT t.ensg,t.gene,r.nTPM FROM tf t JOIN r ON r.Gene=t.ensg ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) DESC, t.ensg LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH top AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.Ensembl AS ensg,t.Gene AS gene,r.nTPM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) DESC,t.Ensembl) rn FROM proteinatlas t JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r ON r.Gene=t.Ensembl AND lower(r.Tissue)='colon' WHERE lower(t.\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factors%') WHERE rn<=20), ms AS (SELECT Gene, Intensity FROM ms_tissue WHERE lower(Tissue)='colon'), ih AS (SELECT Gene, \"IHC tissue name\" AS ihc_tissue, \"Cell type\" AS cell_type, Level, Reliability FROM normal_ihc_data WHERE lower(Tissue)='colon' AND lower(Reliability) IN ('enhanced','supported')) SELECT top.rn,top.ensg,top.gene,top.nTPM,ms.Intensity, string_agg(COALESCE(ih.ihc_tissue,'')||'|'||COALESCE(ih.cell_type,'')||'|'||COALESCE(ih.Level,'')||'|'||COALESCE(ih.Reliability,''), '; ') AS ihc_records FROM top LEFT JOIN ms ON ms.Gene=top.ensg LEFT JOIN ih ON ih.Gene=top.ensg GROUP BY top.rn,top.ensg,top.gene,top.nTPM,ms.Intensity ORDER BY top.rn"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH top AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.Ensembl AS ensg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) DESC,t.Ensembl) rn FROM proteinatlas t JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r ON r.Gene=t.Ensembl AND lower(r.Tissue)='colon' WHERE lower(t.\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factors%') WHERE rn<=20), x AS (SELECT top.rn,ms.Intensity FROM top LEFT JOIN ms_tissue ms ON ms.Gene=top.ensg AND lower(ms.Tissue)='colon') SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE)) AS finite_ms, COUNT(*)-COUNT(TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE)) AS missing_ms, median(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(Intensity AS DOUBLE),0)) AS median_all_zero_filled FROM x"}
